# ZAYVORA Health OS™ — ZKB Knowledge Architecture

## Overview
The ZAYVORA Knowledge Base (ZKB) is an ontological and epistemological knowledge engine unifying canonical Unani Pharmacopoeias with modern botanical taxonomies (World Flora Online, Plants of the World Online) and clinical trial registries.

## Multi-Layer Representation
1. **Canonical Classical Layer (World A):** Unani classical monographs (*Kitab al-Hawi*, *Al-Qanoon*), Mizaj degrees (1° to 4°), Af'al (pharmacological actions), and Musleh/Badal pairs.
2. **Standardized Regulatory Layer (World B):** Unani Pharmacopoeia of India (UPI) Parts I & II, National Formulary of Unani Medicine (NFUM), and Schedule E(1) statutory poisons.
3. **Contemporary Scientific Layer (World C):** Peer-reviewed clinical trials, in-vitro/in-vivo preclinical assays, and chromatographic fingerprints.
4. **Real-World Evidence Layer (World D):** Anonymized longitudinal patient outcomes, PROMs, and post-market pharmacovigilance reports.
